title: Daily and Seasonal Changes
seo_title: Year 1 Science: Daily and Seasonal Changes Worksheets (Australian Curriculum)
standard_text: Describe daily and seasonal changes in the environment and explore how these changes affect everyday life (summary of the Australian Curriculum v9.0 Science content description).
meta_desc: Free Year 1 science worksheets on daily and seasonal changes: day and night, weather, the four seasons in Australia, the wet and dry seasons, and weather charts. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Day turns to night. In southern Australia, summer is in December and winter is in June.
body_html:
How to think about it

The sky and weather change.

  • Day and night change every day.
  • Weather can be sunny, rainy or windy.
  • Summer is hot; winter is cold.
Example

Which season is Christmas in Australia?

December is summer

Answer: summer

Common mistakes

  • Putting Christmas in winter (it is summer in Australia).
  • Thinking the Sun turns off at night.

faq.q: What are the seasons in Australia?
faq.a: Most of Australia has summer (December to February), autumn, winter (June to August) and spring. The north has a wet season and a dry season.

faq.q: What is the difference between weather and seasons?
faq.a: Weather is what it is like outside today. Seasons are times of the year with their own usual weather.

faq.q: How can children track the weather?
faq.a: Keep a weather chart with a symbol for each day, and measure rain or temperature.
